test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of D. Only two people sit between D and G. Only two people sit between E and F. F sits to the immediate left of D. N sits to the immediate right of M.

Who sits at the third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of D.

Only two people sit between D and G.

Only two people sit between E and F.

F sits to the immediate left of D.

N sits to the immediate right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e6a566fe0922edbd9741df860b453e3d9c828e1010f19ad5556fe02c5821459.png] 

So, L sits at the third position from the left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
